clean_pool_digest_schema.encoding: UTF-8, LF, no BOM, no additional Unicode normalization
clean_pool_digest_schema.position_semantics: zero-based loader position; not a dense-model rank
clean_pool_digest_schema.unordered: SHA256 of repeated source_variant_id<TAB>loader_content_sha256<LF> lines sorted lexicographically

evidence_classes.derived: exact deterministic calculations from retained rows
evidence_classes.reconstructed_input: clean pre-encoding pools rebuilt from frozen sources/loaders
evidence_classes.retained: files serialized by the historical or corrected runners
evidence_classes.unavailable: historical runtime state that was never serialized

generation_coverage.scope_note: Only the listed qid-keyed files preserve per-query EM/F1/hallucination scores; other generation artifacts are summaries or scores without query identifiers. No raw prediction text survives.

noninvertibility.answers: EM, F1, and hallucination scores are many-to-one and cannot recover prediction strings
noninvertibility.rankings: saved counts and scalar metrics are many-to-one and cannot identify or order selected passages

reconstruction_dependencies.provenance_note: Exact file hashes govern this post-hoc reconstruction because the working tree contains documented local reproducibility changes.

scope: maximum recoverable execution-artifact evidence without model inference

trigger_rule.fallback: jointly tuned with tau on each seed's pooled validation levels
trigger_rule.gate_semantics: analysis-only oracle/design gate derived from gold titles/qrels; not a deployable label-free trigger
trigger_rule.threshold_candidates: rounded validation Vendi values plus lower/upper extremes
trigger_rule.trigger: raw per-query kNN Vendi < validation-tuned tau
